name: ios-backend-studio
description: Integrate native iOS and Node.js backends with shared cross-platform contracts, Apple system surfaces, and reproducible Xcode/Mac workflows.

interface.longDescription: Build and operate provider-neutral Node.js backends that work with native iOS and other clients. Focused workflows and substantial source-backed references cover shared API contracts, auth, data/offline sync, APNs, widgets, Siri/App Intents, Live Activities, background work, reliability, Xcode and Mac tooling. Preserve existing stacks and verify real runtime capabilities. Includes native Codex, Claude Code and current Kimi packaging.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this iOS and Node.js project, then implement the smallest reliable integration with shared contracts and tests.
Connect this backend to widgets, Siri/App Intents, APNs, or Live Activities using the actual SDK and account boundaries.
Improve this cross-platform release workflow with reproducible Xcode, Node.js, and Mac tooling checks.
